title: Design System: SIMAS — Buku Besar Sekolah

stamp-ink-deep.purpose: Hover/pressed fill; text on a success wash.

stamp-ink-bright.purpose: Focus border and ring; primary fill on the night ground.

stamp-wash.purpose: Success surface and role-chip ground on paper.

stamp-wash-line.purpose: Border of a success wash and of a role chip.

stamp-mist.purpose: Success text on the night ground.

void-red.purpose: Destructive fill, invalid field stroke, error text.

void-red-bright.purpose: Hover state of the destructive fill.

void-red-deep.purpose: Text on a void wash; border of a void panel on night.

void-red-mist.purpose: Error text on the night ground.

void-wash.purpose: Deactivated-account notice and error banner ground on paper.

provisional-amber.purpose: The pending chip text on the night ground. Amber means awaiting a human stamp — nothing else.

ledger-paper.purpose: The record surface on the school portal; text on every filled button.

form-grey.purpose: The school portal's page ground; record-row hover tint.

rule.purpose: The hairline on paper; body text on the night ground.

rule-strong.purpose: Input stroke on paper; field labels on the night ground.

pencil-grey.purpose: Secondary text, hints, empty-state copy, label text in console definition lists.

pencil-deep.purpose: Mid-weight label needing more presence than Pencil Grey.

faint-pencil.purpose: Meta text, placeholders, slugs, console navigation links.

ledger-ink.purpose: Headings and strong text on paper; the public form's submit fill; console panels at 50%.

board-ink.purpose: Field labels on paper; hover of the ink button; console input strokes.

chalk-bright.purpose: Headings and strong text on the night ground.

night-rule.purpose: The console's hairline and hover border step.

title.purpose: The single heading of a page. Never a hero, never repeated.

body.purpose: Default and floor: labels, buttons, paragraphs, list values. No text below 14px.

label.purpose: Form labels and weight-500 emphasis inside body copy. Weight is the only emphasis tool.

meta.purpose: Errors, hints, timestamps, chips, status words, empty states. The only smaller size.

slug.purpose: The only monospace in the product: slugs, hosts, and identifiers a human must verify.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: The raised auth and public-form card only. The entire shadow budget of the system.

motion.name: transition-colors
motion.purpose: The system's only transition — Tailwind's default duration and timing. Color, background-color, border-color.

motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: Primary (Stamp) buttons depress 1px on active. Nothing else moves; nothing bounces or slides.

motion.name: navigation-progress
motion.purpose: The Inertia progress bar on every navigation — the one off-palette value in the app (gray-600, not zinc). It is intentionally neutral: a navigation is in progress, not confirmed.

components.name: Button — Stamp (primary)
components.description: The one filled action on an authenticated school surface: the only green that means go, done, or permitted.
components.css: .ds-btn-stamp { background: #047857; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.43; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-stamp:hover { background: #065f46; } .ds-btn-stamp:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-stamp:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #059669; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-stamp[disabled] { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Button — Ink (public surface)
components.description: The submit of an unauthenticated public form. Never green: green is a credential of a verified session.
components.css: .ds-btn-ink { background: #18181b; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.43; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ink:hover { background: #3f3f46; } .ds-btn-ink:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ink:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #059669; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-ink[disabled] { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Button — Void (destructive)
components.description: Deactivation and rejection only. No press offset — a void is committed, not pressed.
components.css: .ds-btn-void { background: #dc2626; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.43; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-void:hover { background: #ef4444; } .ds-btn-void:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #dc2626; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-void[disabled] { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Input — Text field
components.description: Label above, error below, placeholder never the label. Focus turns the stroke green with a 20%-opacity ring.
components.html: Email sudah digunakan.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; max-width: 360px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.43; color: #3f3f46; } .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #ffffff; color: #18181b; border: 1px solid #d4d4d8; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.43; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #a1a1aa; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #059669; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(5, 150, 105, 0.2); } .ds-input[aria-invalid='true'] { border-color: #ef4444; } .ds-error { font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.33; color: #dc2626; }

components.name: Card — Ledger record panel
components.description: A record on paper: 8px corners, 1px hairline, 24px padding, no shadow. The raised variant (12px, 32px, one shadow) belongs only to the pre-context auth card.
components.html:
Daftar Pengguna

Kelola akun staf sekolah: profil, peran, dan status aktif.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #18181b; } .ds-card-sub { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.43; color: #71717a; } .ds-card-raised { border-radius: 12px; padding: 32px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); }

components.name: Panel — Night (console)
components.description: The same record on the night ground: translucent ink panel, night hairline, bright chalk text. No shadow — a shadow on night is invisible. The panel also owns the console's action set: a void, a ghost cancel, and a brighter stamp fill that holds up against the night ground.
components.html:
Setujui — koreksi data bila perlu

Data di form ini menjadi data final tenant.
components.css: .ds-night { background: #09090b; padding: 24px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-panel-night { background: rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.5); border: 1px solid #27272a; border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px; } .ds-night-title { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.43; color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-night-sub { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.33; color: #71717a; } .ds-night-actions { display: flex; gap: 12px; margin-top: 16px; } .ds-btn-void { background: #dc2626; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.43; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-void:hover { background: #ef4444; } .ds-btn-ghost-night { background: transparent; color: #e4e4e7; border: 1px solid #3f3f46; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.43; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-ghost-night:hover { background: rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.5); } .ds-btn-stamp-night { background: #059669; color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 16px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.43; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-btn-stamp-night:hover { background: #10b981; } .ds-btn-ghost-night:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #059669; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Chip — Role
components.description: A pill means status, nothing else. Role chips are green on a green wash; the muted variant marks the absence of a role.
components.css: .ds-chip-role { display: inline-block; background: #ecfdf5; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; color: #047857; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.33; } .ds-chip-muted { display: inline-block; background: #fafafa; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; color: #71717a; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.33; }

components.name: Chip — Pending
components.description: An entry received but not yet stamped by a human. Amber is never a warning about the user's own work.
components.css: .ds-chip-pending { display: inline-block; background: rgba(69, 26, 3, 0.4); border: 1px solid rgba(146, 64, 14, 0.6); color: #fcd34d; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 10px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.33; }

components.name: Banner — Flash
components.description: A fact that just happened. Not dismissible, never color-only: the sentence states what happened.
components.css: .ds-banner-success { margin: 0; background: #ecfdf5; border: 1px solid #a7f3d0; color: #065f46; border-radius: 8px; padding: 12px 16px; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.43; } .ds-banner-void { background: #fef2f2; border: 1px solid #fecaca; color: #b91c1c; }

components.name: Record row
components.description: The system's signature pattern: a 12px stack of hairline cards, whole row clickable, status right-aligned. Hover steps the border and tints the ground — never a shadow.
components.css: .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #e4e4e7; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px 20px; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1), background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-row:hover { border-color: #d4d4d8; background: #fafafa; } .ds-row:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #059669; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-name { display: block; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.43; color: #18181b; } .ds-row-email { display: block; margin-top: 2px; font-size: 12px; line-height: 1.33; color: #71717a; } .ds-row-status { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.33; color: #71717a; }

components.name: Top bar
components.description: 64px, text only, hairline underneath. No sidebar, no tabs, no breadcrumbs, no avatar — depth is expressed by going back.
components.html: PenggunaUndangTambah Pengguna
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e4e4e7; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-topbar-name { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #18181b; } .ds-topbar-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-topbar-stamp { border: 1px solid #047857; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #047857; text-decoration: none; background: #ffffff; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-topbar-stamp:hover { background: #ecfdf5; } .ds-topbar-ghost { font-size: 14px; color: #71717a; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-topbar-ghost:hover { color: #18181b; }

components.name: Top bar — Night (console)
components.description: The same 64px bar on the night ground: chalk for the section name, faint pencil for links. No avatar, no user menu, no icon — the operator's name is not on the page.

components.css: .ds-topbar-night { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 64px; padding: 0 24px; background: #09090b; border-bottom: 1px solid #27272a; font-family: 'Instrument Sans', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-topbar-night .ds-night-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #f4f4f5; } .ds-topbar-night-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; } .ds-topbar-night-links a { font-size: 14px; color: #a1a1aa; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); } .ds-topbar-night-links a:hover { color: #e4e4e7; }

narrative.overview:
SIMAS is a ledger, not a dashboard. The metaphor is the bound register a school keeps
in its headmaster's office: ruled lines, one ink, a stamp that means *this is
confirmed*, and nothing on the page that isn't an entry, a rule, or the name of a
thing. The interface never performs. It records, marks, and gets out of the way of
the person who has the job to do — the teacher on a phone at 7am, the school admin
at a desk, the provider operator clearing an approval queue at night.

The personality is calm, exact, and unhurried, in plain Bahasa Indonesia. The copy
register is institutional and serviceable: *Daftarkan sekolah Anda*, *Tidak ada
pengajuan pending. Semua beres.* No marketing enthusiasm, no cheerfulness, no
playfulness. The single green in the system is not decorative — it is a stamp, and
stamps are rare by definition. Everything else is paper, rule, and grey pencil.

Density is deliberate. The system runs on three type sizes (20px title, 14px body,
12px meta) at a 14px base, with 8px corners, 1px rules, and generous page padding
(24px sides, 40px top) so that a dense list of records still breathes. The product's
primary user is on a low-end Android phone on a slow connection, so the system spends
its weight on legibility and does almost nothing with motion: color transitions and
a 1px press on primary buttons are the entire motion vocabulary.

Two grounds, one language. The school portal is paper (`form-grey` page, white
records, `rule` hairlines). The provider console is the same ledger at night
(`night-board` page, translucent night panels, `night-rule` hairlines) — the same
voice and the same component shapes, lit differently, because that operator is
working through a queue alone. Unauthenticated public surfaces are the third case:
paper and ink only.
keyCharacteristics: One green (Stamp Ink) and one meaning: confirmed, permitted, actionable.
Three type sizes, one family, two weights of emphasis (500, 600).
8px corners for everything; pills reserved for status chips; 12px only on the raised auth card.
Flat surfaces separated by 1px rules and a change of paper tone; one shadow in the entire system.
Words, not icons — every control is labeled in Bahasa Indonesia.
One centered column, fluid, with no breakpoints defined anywhere in the system.
Two grounds (paper / night) sharing one component language and one voice.

rules.name: The One Green Rule
rules.body: Stamp Ink appears only where something is confirmed, permitted, or actionable. One filled green button per screen, plus links, focus, and success. If a second green region appears, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Public Form Rule
rules.body: On an unauthenticated public surface, the submit is Ledger Ink, not green (the school application form's Daftarkan sekolah button is ink). Green is a credential of a verified session; the public form has not earned one.

rules.name: The Void Rule
rules.body: Red means voided or blocked — a user is deactivated, an application is rejected, a field is invalid. Nothing in this system hard-deletes a record, so red never appears on a "remove permanently" control.

rules.name: The Provisional Rule
rules.body: Amber is only ever pending. Never a warning about the user's own work, never a caution before an action.

rules.name: The Three-Size Rule
rules.body: Twenty, fourteen, twelve. If a screen seems to need a fourth size, it needs less text or a clearer title instead. A ledger has no cover.

rules.name: The Weight Is the Emphasis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from 400 → 500 → 600 and from grey level, never from a new size, a color shift, or an italic. Ledger Ink for headings, Pencil Grey for secondary, Faint Pencil for meta.

rules.name: The Slug Rule
rules.body: Monospace is reserved for identifiers a human must verify or type. Never for prose, labels, or numbers that merely happen to be numeric.

rules.name: The Ruled Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate surfaces with a 1px rule before you consider a shadow. If a component needs elevation to be legible, it needs a rule instead.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: shadow-sm on a centered card is the entire shadow budget. No lifted hover states, no elevated modals, no shadow on the console (a shadow on night-board is invisible anyway — the night ground separates with tone and rule).

dos: Do use the palette's own semantics and always pair color with a word: green is confirmed, red is voided, amber is pending — and every chip, banner, and status line in the system says the word too (aktif, nonaktif, pending). Never let color be the only carrier.
Do keep body text at 14px and page titles at 20px, reaching for 12px meta rather than inventing a size.
Do use 8px corners for anything interactive or surface-level, pills only for status chips, and 12px only on the raised auth card.
Do separate surfaces with a 1px Rule (paper) or Night Rule (night) before considering any shadow.
Do mirror the ground: paper surfaces take Ledger Paper / Form Grey / Rule, the console takes Night Board / translucent night panels / Night Rule. Translucency is a night-only device.

Do put the label above the field with the error below it, and keep aria-invalid and aria-describedby wired to that error — the existing auth input sets this precedent and every new field must match it.
Do write every user-facing string in plain, serviceable Bahasa Indonesia: one statement, no marketing register, provider referred to as "tim kami".
donts: Don't add a second accent. There is one green and it means one thing; a new hue for a new feature breaks the stamp.
Don't use green for a submit on an unauthenticated public surface — the public application form's button is ink.
Don't use red to mean "cancel," and don't build a hard-delete control: this system voids and marks records, it never removes them.
Don't introduce gradients, glass, blur, or shadows into surfaces that are currently ruled and flat, and don't lift record rows on hover.

Don't ship interactive targets at 16px. The current checkbox is 16px; that is a gap, not a precedent. The primary user is on a low-end phone — touch targets on new surfaces must be at least 44px even though the recorded type scale stays at 14px.
Don't add a display size, hero type, or marketing headline anywhere in the product, and don't reach for a fourth type size to create hierarchy.
Don't replace a word with an icon. The system has no icon vocabulary; every control is a labeled word in Bahasa Indonesia.
Don't put text in monospace unless it is a slug, a host, or an identifier a human must verify character by character.
Don't assume a breakpoint exists. None are defined; new surfaces must introduce responsive behavior deliberately, mobile-first.

landingLembar.scope: Lembar world: the public landing at /, the school sign-in pages (Identity Auth) and the PPDB applicant account pages (Ppdb Account: Login, Register, ForgotPassword, SetPassword, VerifyNotice), scoped under .lembar. Does not govern the app; the app tokens and rules do not govern it. Colour and typography primitives live in DESIGN.md frontmatter under the landing- prefix.

landing-ink.purpose: The printed form: frames, bubble rings, field borders, numerals, link underline, closing band, selection.

landing-ink-deep.purpose: Ink as text (field labels, table heads, asides); hover of graphite button and links.

landing-ink-line.purpose: 1px row rules, timing rail border and unfilled marks.

landing-ink-tint.purpose: Sheet band and sheet header ground; inverted button hover; 60% marks the human review step.

landing-graphite.purpose: Text, bubble fills, filled timing marks, corner marks, primary button, focus ring.

landing-pencil.purpose: Secondary text, leads, nav at rest.

landing-paper.purpose: Page and every framed surface; text on the cobalt band (90%).

landing-correction.purpose: The teacher red pen: border and message of a field that needs correcting, nothing else.

landing-display.purpose: Hero and closing headlines; 2.75rem / 4.25rem sm / 5.25rem xl, Archivo width 72%.

landing-band.purpose: Section heads in sheet bands; 2rem / 2.75rem sm, width 75%.

landing-title.purpose: Module, step and principle titles, width 85%.

landing-code.purpose: Azeret Mono 500 for digits and numerals only.

motion.name: landing-pencil-fill
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: bubbles fill mark by mark. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: landing-timing-mark
motion.purpose: Timing rail marks fill with reading progress.

components.name: Lembar button - primary
components.description: Graphite action button; inverted variant only on the cobalt band.
components.css: .ds-lembar-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 48px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 2px; background: #27313c; color: #fff; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-lembar-btn:hover { background: #006b9c; } .ds-lembar-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-lembar-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #27313c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Lembar bubble
components.description: The one mark: cobalt ring, graphite fill when chosen.
components.css: .ds-lembar-bubble { display: inline-block; width: 20px; height: 20px; border: 1px solid #09a8ed; border-radius: 9999px; background: #fff; margin-right: 8px; } .ds-lembar-bubble--on { background: #27313c; border-color: #27313c; }

components.name: Lembar sheet band
components.description: Full-bleed tinted band with 2px cobalt rules; section head.
components.css: .ds-lembar-band { background: #ecf7fe; border-top: 2px solid #09a8ed; border-bottom: 2px solid #09a8ed; padding: 24px 20px; } .ds-lembar-band h2 { margin: 0; font-family: Archivo, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.02em; font-stretch: 75%; color: #27313c; }

rules.name: The Two Inks Rule
rules.body: Cobalt prints, graphite marks. Anything the form is (rules, labels, rings, frames) is cobalt; anything a person wrote (fills, answers, the action they take) is graphite. A third hue, green included, does not appear.

rules.name: The Width Axis Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from Archivo's width axis as much as size: condensed (72-85%) for heads, normal for reading, expanded (118%) only for the wordmark.

rules.name: The Written Digit Rule
rules.body: Mono means a digit a hand wrote on the sheet. It is not a code font for labels or decoration.

rules.name: The One Pencil Rule
rules.body: One authored motion per page, and it is the act of filling the sheet. No scroll reveals, parallax or looping animation.
